summary: Google DeepMind researchers analyze geo-cultural bias in safety evaluation datasets, finding cultural zone membership predicts safety ratings and testing LLMs as rater surrogates and triage tools for culturally sensitive content.

practices.reason: Findings suggest safety evaluation methodology should account for geo-cultural variation and use LLMs as triage tools for flagging culturally sensitive items rather than relying on homogeneous rater pools.
practices.quote: We evaluate LLMs as both rater surrogates and triage tools, finding that current LLMs do not reliably stand in for raters, though they can help prioritize culturally sensitive items for human annotation.
